sentence: The south part is drier than the north, so bring water.
synonym: The southern area has less rain than the north
synonymNote: 两者都表示南部比北部更干燥，意思相同

distractors.word: The south part is colder than the north
distractors.note: colder指更冷，不是更干燥，意思不同

distractors.word: The south part is wetter than the north
The south part is larger than the north
distractors.note: larger指面积更大，与干燥无关
